roster.note: China's first Moon mission — an orbiter that mapped the lunar surface and announced China as a lunar power
China's first soft landing on the Moon, carrying the Yutu rover — the first spacecraft to land there since the 1970s
the first spacecraft ever to land on the far side of the Moon — a place that cannot see Earth, reached using the Queqiao relay satellite
China's first lunar sample return — the first fresh Moon rocks brought to Earth by anyone since 1976
the first sample return from the far side of the Moon — material no one had ever held before

roster.name: Queqiao relay
roster.note: a satellite placed beyond the Moon to relay signals from the far side, which never faces Earth — the enabling trick behind Chang'e-4 and -6

roster.name: Crewed landing
roster.note: China's stated goal of landing astronauts on the Moon before 2030, using a new deep-space crew capsule and lander

roster.name: ILRS
roster.note: the International Lunar Research Station — China's planned robotic-then-crewed base at the lunar south pole, built with international partners as an alternative to Artemis
